notes: The Map is a trail of 8 real monuments, no longer one temple per HSK level: the Oriental Pearl Tower in Shanghai, the Leifeng Pagoda in Hangzhou, the Yellow Crane Tower in Wuhan, the Canton Tower in Guangzhou, Hongya Cave in Chongqing, the Potala Palace in Lhasa, the Big Wild Goose Pagoda in Xi'an and the Temple of Heaven in Beijing. They are built one after another by every word you prove, whatever its level: the first needs 24 proven words, each next one more. Fast build now picks known words from the lowest level up
